note: Maintainer decision 11 (#1306 finding 1): the blank donor (variable 15662) is pinned `answer-sweden`, the slug its documented-blank `[[representation.matrix]]` gives the answer variable it converts. The matrix answers join the scope's naming after the native names convert, so before the fix no `naming_slug_collision` was raised and the only symptom was an overbroad alias window (`representation-alias-window-overbroad-when-its-slug-names-two-compiled-variables`). Both names are refused, each located at its curation entry: the donor's [[variable]] entry and the matrix answer (case id `<matrix>:<answer key>`, located at the matrix). The refused answer is withheld; `answer-abroad`, whose slug nobody else takes, still publishes. Source shared with `matrix-blank-answers-inherit-the-donor-code-list`.
fails_if: `compile_curation` (curation_compile.py) runs `refuse_slug_collisions` before the matrix answers join the scope's naming, or not at all, so the donor and the answer share `answer-sweden` with no `naming_slug_collision` and the answer publishes
